resources.string: Shared durability · resets daily at 00:00 KST
From the first start, each runner\'s max shoe durability is added.
Shared stamina is used up. It earns again when a new runner starts and adds theirs.
You finished today\'s crew run in %1$s
You\'re on a crew run now
Without phone verification you\'re left out of the headcount bonus only. You can still run together and earn with your shoe.
The next level we reached together
Lv.%1$d reached · crew stamina +%2$s%% · crew reward +%3$s%%
Each member\'s valid distance adds up. Crew levels never go down.
Today\'s crew run is open again
Shoes are yours, stamina is shared
We add up the max durability of the shoes picked at start, plus the crew level effect. Everyone earns with their own shoe stats.
Only shared stamina is used. Your own shoes don\'t wear and stay available for free runs. Paused runners use nothing.
Recording continues. It never switches to your own durability, and shared stamina can\'t be repaired.
Even if you switch crews. Pausing is fine. Once you end, you can\'t rejoin, and if you\'re the last one left it ends automatically.
Only same-crew members within %1$dm at start and %2$d min later, with phone verification, count for the bonus. You can still run without it.
Shared stamina and the daily run reset. Total distance and crew level stay.
Headcount and level bonuses are added together. Crew rewards are separate from the personal daily cap, and there is no crew cap for now.
Only one tier for the counted headcount applies. The crew level reward is added on top.
Rewards use your shoe stats. Its max durability is added to the shared stamina. Your own shoe doesn\'t wear during a crew run.
This is a preview. It\'s confirmed %1$d min after start by verified crew members still within %2$dm.
You can start together even at 0. The max durability of your picked shoe is added when you start. Shared stamina can\'t be repaired.
You already did today\'s crew run in %1$s. It\'s once a day even if you switch crews.
A crew run needs at least 2 ready runners to start.
One crew run a day. You can pause, but once you end you can\'t rejoin today. The headcount bonus is confirmed 2 minutes after start.
Everyone running is using the remaining shared stamina. At 0 only earning stops and the run keeps recording. Your own shoe durability isn\'t used.
Shared stamina is used up · earning stopped, recording continues
Phone not verified · left out of the headcount only
You\'re still together 2 minutes after start. Shoe stats aren\'t mixed — everyone earns with the shoe they picked.
Of the %1$d who started, %2$d were outside %3$dm at the check or not phone-verified, so they weren\'t counted. Your run keeps recording.
Fewer than 2 verified crew members were confirmed together 2 minutes after start. Your shoe reward and level reward stay.
You were the last one, so your crew run ended automatically. Your record so far is saved. You can\'t join another crew run today.
Once you end, you can\'t rejoin today. To rest, use pause. Switching crews doesn\'t give today\'s crew run back.
Crew runs earn from shared stamina. Your energy and shoe durability aren\'t used.
Shared stamina is used up, so nothing is earned now.
Crew rewards are separate from the personal daily cap.
Your own shoe durability wasn\'t used.
Ended automatically after everyone else finished.
This run was invalid, so it wasn\'t added to the crew distance. Crew levels never go down.
This wasn\'t counted as a crew run. You already did today\'s crew run, or you didn\'t start together in this room.
Crew rewards show after the server settles them.
Next crew run from 00:00 KST tomorrow. Free runs use your own shoe durability.
